notes.title: Albert Innovation Demo - Technical Visual Update
notes.content:
[h2][/h2][h2]Hello everyone ![/h2][p][/p][p]It's been a while ! Like a really long time (almost 3 years, damn ːcleansealː)[/p][p]As we've been preparing this ambitious game for quite a while, we wanted to update this old demo with the new technologies we've decided to exploit in our pipelines.

[b]No new content ahead[/b], only the [b]improvements of the visual and technical pipelines [/b]of the game.
Here's a showcase for you !
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4UeSXsQOlA8"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Major Update content[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Light[/b] has been entirely remade from scratch.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual Effect[/b] improvements basically everywhere.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimisation[/b] has been also reworked from scracth.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gameplay Tweak [/b]even though it's praticaly a walk-simulator.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug fix [/b]like in an ABSURD amount.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]We re-made the entire demo ON the demo already existing. This new version of this demo is better, but requires a higher configuration, even though it has been optimized.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Where are we now ?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We're not doing much communicating, as there's simply nothing to communicate yet, but we can assure you that with every passing day we're working on the most sinister and frightening experience possible.[/p][p][/p][p]This current demo on steam has little to do with the real experience we're preparing for the full game. We're improving the art pipeline, actively writing this intricately branching story, and enjoying laying the foundations of the universe's dark horror.
So yes, we are still working slowly and gently on this experience, and we look forward to bringing you more details in the future![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]What's the future?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Albert Innovation's development continues over the coming years, but the video game industry remains a challenging environment, with its load of complications.[/p][p]Today, Albert Innovation has finally become our number 1 priority. Some of us are now working full time on the development of this game, time has been given to us, and our motivation remains unchanged.[/p][p]

That's all for now, thanks for your attention and we hope you'll enjoy this improved experience !

Cheers everyone,
Lancelot[/p]

notes.title: Change of publication format
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone,[/h2]

Few days has passed after the release of Albert Innovation episode 1.
You have enjoyed this introduction to the game universe, and almost 900 people have already played the game! So we sincerely thank you.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42397012/ab0b4fedf7ff741a6c3efde8ccd741966e0ef303.png[/img]

[h2]New publication format ?[/h2]

After some thought on our part, we decided to go for the most interesting publishing format for us.
[h3]Albert Innovation will be released in one big game![/h3]
The episodic format classically used by some independent developers has many good points for building an audience. Only, for our own comfort and for the quality we wish to place on the sequel, we prefer to take the time we need to be able to give you a single intense and immersive experience.

[h2]The consequences ?[/h2]

This choice modifies some of the points discussed earlier.
[list]
[*] The development time will be long (in more than a year and a half).
[*] We are aiming for a game time of 3h30 to 4h.
[*] Episode 1 will be a demo, it will serve as an introduction to the universe.
[*] The price of the full game is not decided yet.
[*] We will regularly talk about the progress on our networks.
[/list]
[h2]Finally...[/h2]

A big thank you to the reception of the game, already 25 reviews in 1 week with 91% of positive is very encouraging!
We hope that the sequel will be up to your expectations, in the meantime you can join the [url=https://discord.gg/YdqkAym2e5]official discord[/url] if you want to discuss with us or tell us about bugs you found.

see you soon !

-Delirium Den
